$comment: Single configuration source for the NodeMation pipeline. Workflows contain mechanics only; every name, label, policy and target lives here. A loader workflow syncs this file into Redis key cfg:pipeline; every workflow reads that key at the start of a run.

labels.$comment: hold = not approved; pr_open = a PR exists; shipped = merged; needs_triage = a person must look; spec_present = the issue already carries its scenarios, so triage is skipped and the spec marker is set directly.

dependabot.author: dependabot[bot]
dependabot.$comment: Dependency-bot PRs are pre-approved. Tested means: every required status context on the base branch is green; if the branch declares none, every check run named in `checks` is green. Other jobs never block.

chain.$comment: Ordering inside a stream. Primary: GitHub issue dependencies (blocked_by). Fallback when that API is unavailable: a body line '<blocked_by_line> #N'.

build.$comment: Build stage: the build-queue consumer dispatches this workflow on the runner; the job runs the coding agent in a fresh checkout and opens the PR as the bot.

feedback.$comment: Review feedback on a pipeline PR becomes a build item on the same branch. Dedupe per review/comment id.

ci.$comment: Which check runs count as the tests of a pull request when the base branch declares no required status contexts.

repair.$comment: A failing required (or configured CI) check on a pipeline PR becomes a repair build on that PR's branch. Attempts are counted per PR; at the cap the PR and its issue get a comment and the needs-triage label and nothing more runs.
